title: CH-A10: exact reduct enumeration output
description: Phase B (prereg/v3-core-reduct-correction.md, tag prereg-p5-v3): checkers/reduct_check.py's output. Exhaustive enumeration of every reduct (Definition 5) over the candidate power set, with subset pruning; not a two-sided hypothesis -- the reported numbers are the result. core_attributes/redundant_attributes use v3's renamed vocabulary (prereg/v3-core-reduct-correction.md's Renaming plan), not v1/v2's participating_properties/coverage_list, which stay byte-frozen under their own names.

model.description: Which reachable-set construction this enumeration ran against, e.g. 'v2' or a fixture name.

candidate_properties.description: The full candidate set -- the power set enumerated has 2^len(candidate_properties) members before pruning.

subsets_considered.description: Subsets actually tested for sufficiency/minimality after pruning (a sufficient set's supersets are never re-tested for minimality; an insufficient set's subsets are never tested for sufficiency) -- always <= 2^len(candidate_properties), reported so exhaustiveness-with-pruning is distinguishable from a sample.

reducts.description: Every reduct found (Definition 5): sufficient and minimal. Each entry sorted, deduplicated.

minimum_reducts.description: The subset of reducts whose cardinality equals minimum_reduct_cardinality.

core_attributes.description: Definition 6: the intersection of every entry in reducts. Must equal sufficiency_check.schema.json's core_attributes tested_set when both run on the same model (cross-checked, not assumed equal).

core_is_unique_reduct.description: True iff reducts has exactly one member and it equals core_attributes -- Proposition 1' claim 3's antecedent, decided here per instance.

redundant_attributes.description: candidate_properties minus core_attributes -- dispensable from at least one reduct, the v3-renamed analogue of v1/v2's coverage_list.

proposition_1_prime_claim_1_identity_hol.description: Machine-check of Proposition 1' claim 1 ('Definition 1 computes the core'): the core recomputed via participation.compute_p_star (Definition 1's witness search) equals the core recomputed independently via the intersection of every reduct this enumeration found (Definition 6's literal definition, against Definition 4 directly) -- two different code paths, confirmed to agree, not assumed to.

proposition_1_prime_claim_2_core_subset_.description: Machine-check of Proposition 1' claim 2: the core (however computed) is a subset of every individual reduct found, checked directly against each one, not only inferred from the intersection arithmetic that produced it.
